four_prism_parity_cancellation.interpretation: four prisms can cancel every rooted parity using a motif that passes all induced lambda/mu upper-cap and interlacing controls; extendibility to 99 vertices remains unknown

ordinary_adjacency_polynomials.consequence: a nonconstant rooted prism vector cannot be recovered as diag(p(A)); ordinary adjacency-polynomial identities see only walk-regular scalar data
ordinary_adjacency_polynomials.needed_extension: Hadamard products or explicit triangle/prism incidence tensors
ordinary_adjacency_polynomials.single_prism_binary_identity: (I+A)*chi_S is the indicator of the 60 outside vertices having exactly one neighbor in the prism

limitations: The code theorem constrains f mod 2 but does not force it nonzero in general.
The 12-vertex cancellation motif is not a full target graph.
No strict n3 upper bound or graph nonexistence result follows.
next_route: Test whether the locally compatible C4 box K3 parity-cancellation motif or the 3-by-3 rook regular set can extend through the full 99-vertex lambda/mu closure. Incidence-code arguments need the actual binary rank/kernel of B or extra restrictions on the triangle-prism graph beyond its cycle space.

binary_incidence_code.boundary: C0 has at least 44 binary dimensions; these universal code relations alone do not force f mod 2 to be nonzero
binary_incidence_code.cycle_space_boundary: D*1 is the odd-degree boundary of the selected edge set in the graph whose vertices are triangles and whose edges are prisms
binary_incidence_code.dual_characterization: C0^perp={x : B^T*x is constant on all 231 triangles}
binary_incidence_code.dual_locality_boundary: apart from zero, every universal parity check on f uses at least 36 vertices; the all-ones total-parity check has weight 99
binary_incidence_code.even_triangle_code: C0={Bz : z in F2^231 and wt(z) even}
binary_incidence_code.parity_vector: f mod 2 = H*1 = B*(D*1) lies in C0
binary_incidence_code.prism_factorization: H=B*D, where D is the triangle-versus-prism edge-incidence matrix and H is vertex-versus-prism incidence

triangle_even_check_support.proof: restricted eigenvalue bounds applied to chi_S^T*A*chi_S=7*|S|, plus even |S|

universal_congruences: x dot f = 0 mod 2 whenever every graph triangle has the same x-sum

distinct_prism_overlap.proof: five shared vertices force the two missing vertices to have the same three neighbors, contradicting lambda=1 if adjacent and mu=2 if nonadjacent

three_prism_parity_branch.consequence_for_total_P_3: f mod 2 cannot vanish when the whole graph has exactly three prisms, because the parity-cancelling union already contains six
three_prism_parity_branch.interpretation: the rook motif is locally and spectrally parameter-compatible; it is not a full 99-vertex graph construction
three_prism_parity_branch.three_even_support_set_partition: three six-sets with zero symmetric difference partition their nine vertices into three size-three pairwise-intersection blocks

vector_refined_N14_bound.limitations: The P=2 overlap theorem sharpens the seven-N14 numerator but not its final even bound. For P>=4, local parity cancellation is parameter-compatible.
vector_refined_N14_bound.strict_improvement: If P=1 (n3=4155), N14<=4950 instead of the Wave100 scalar bound 4952.
